alternatives.option: Remove backend from DEFAULT_CONFIG and treat undefined as auto
alternatives.reason_rejected: deepMerge iterates target keys only — user-set explicit backend values would be silently dropped
signature churn across all callers for one flag

context: Built v2.0.0-beta.1 scope (V1-V5) on branch v2.0-beta: engines 22.13 + CI 22/24 + prerelease dist-tag routing, auto backend resolution with legacy nudge, SUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION=2 with migrate stamps, init stamping, opt-in auto-migrate, upgrade docs. Full gates green (1063 tests, SOAK_SCALE=5).
rationale: loadConfig's deepMerge only copies keys present in the TARGET (DEFAULT_CONFIG), so removing the default key would silently drop a user's explicit storage.backend, and a loadConfig-signature side-channel for explicitness would churn every caller. The "auto" sentinel survives the merge, keeps explicit files/sqlite pins working unchanged, and localizes the resolution rule in src/storage/backend-resolve.ts with the ambiguity rule: anything unreadable/malformed counts as legacy content so misdetection lands on files (safe), never an empty database.
summary: Implemented the v2 default backend flip as an "auto" sentinel in DEFAULT_CONFIG resolved at createStores time, not a blind default change
